description:
FILED s536j (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08), found probing #4701 (scratch/s536j/p/n3.pl).  PRE-EXISTING (main 3139fcb0 and the s536j tree alike).

    my $y = Foo::nob; print "$y\n";     # no `use strict`, no sub Foo::nob anywhere
      perl 5.40.3:  Foo::nob
      PCL:          dies "Undefined subroutine &Foo::nob called"

A package-QUALIFIED bareword that names no sub is, without `strict subs`, the bareword string -- the same reading as the unqualified `my $y = nob;` -- and the spelling `- Foo::nob` / `-Foo::nob` already gets it right (the negation path asks Pl::PExpr::_bareword_callable_here, which answers 'no' for an undeclared qualified name).  The plain term path lowers the Word as a CALL regardless.  Under `use strict` perl refuses the program at compile time ("Bareword \"Foo::nob\" not allowed"), so only non-strict code reaches it; a CPAN-shaped instance is a class name used as a value without `->` (`my $class = Foo::Bar;`), which perl also reads as the string when no sub Foo::Bar exists.

Where: the term lowering of a bare qualified Word (ExprToCL / PExpr's bareword-call decision, #266's classifier answers 'no' here).  Probe the class-name shape and the strict refusal before fixing.


=== DONE (s537a, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-10 .. 11-13; commits 9e939603 + the fix-forwards 9ab1c946 and 526c864c on the s537a branch, rebased over MAIN-READY-87; shas as of the rebase over main b620405f) ===
FIXED: in `PExpr::handle_subcalls`' end-of-expression branch, a package-QUALIFIED word the callable classifier answers 'no' for, with no `->` / `=>` after it in the source, is marked unplaceable at ANY position (`_mark_unplaceable_bareword` -> `p-bareword-value`, asked of the image at run time): `my $y = Foo::nob;`, `return Foo::ret`, `(Foo::Bar)`, `print Foo::nob;` read the string; a sub that exists at run time (imported past the export scan, BEGIN-installed, declared ABOVE) is still called; a sub declared BELOW stays the string (perl does not know it yet).  `use strict`: PCL still a call that dies at run time where perl refuses at compile time (principle 9).
FIX-FORWARD (found by this batch's own corpus-diff, perl-tests/method.t): the first cut also turned a qualified bareword HANDLE into the string -- `open Colour::H1, ...`, `tell` / `seek` / `eof` / `binmode` / `fileno` / `close` / `truncate`, `opendir(Q::D, ...)` + `readdir` / `closedir`, `-f Q::A`, `stat Q::A` were spelled `(p-bareword-value "Q::A")` and readdir read nothing.  `_bareword_slot_word` now reads the `_bareword_runtime` mark as the funcall shape and the taker (`_read_star_slot_bareword`'s builtin half, `_expr_slot_bareword_operand`) clears it -- every slot is main's emission again (scratch/s537a/p/m3i.pl), and three pre-existing #1996 marks in handle slots became handles too (`syswrite Q::W, ...`, `print {Q::W} ...`, `write(Q::W)`; runtime identical, m3k.pl).
FIX-FORWARD 2 (found by the wide A/B: t/op/attrs.t `::pass;`, main::pass defined by test.pl at BEGIN, was NOT called): `%p-resolve-sub-symbol` split "::pass" into the package "" -- a leading `::` is main.  ONE splitter `%p-split-symbolic-name` now serves the sub resolver and the dynamic glob (`*{"::x"} = sub {...}` built a package "" and `&{"::f"}` died "Undefined subroutine &::f" on main too).  And a call built from a Word an EARLIER parse marked unplaceable dropped the stale mark: main died on `BEGIN { *Foo::hi = sub {...} } sub g { my $x = Foo::hi; }` (the head was emitted as the leaf FORM `(|(p-bareword-value "Foo|::|pl-hi")|)`), and #4762 reached it at `::hello;`.
GUARD: Pl/t/bareword-call-01.t rows 42-43 (#4762, inverse on main), 44 (a leading `::`: main dies), 45 (the stale mark: main dies), 46 (the handle slots; inverse on 33d96dd4 prints `0 0 -1`).  NAME-RESOLUTION change: gate-SET scan IDENTICAL over both populations (638 files); the sweep is its gate (session log).
BARS (the combined tree over MAIN-READY-87, HEAD 7cd511ac): FULL gate 369 / 12,018 -> 12,046 PASS (+ tr-01.t row 9 = 12,047); FULL sweep GATE clean 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST, TOTAL 18,795 -> 18,796 (tr.t +1 = #1493, by edit), drops 5 = census; corpus-diff vs 23f0f917 3 / 111; wide emission A/B 2,053 files 29 DIFF explained / RCDIFF 0; gate-SET scan 638 files IDENTICAL over both populations; ir-host-leak 31 = 31; ir-conform 328 / 0; EVERYDAY 116 -> 116 of 122 (NEW 0); compile time unchanged (Calc.pm 5.52 -> 5.51 s).  Detail: docs/session-log.md, section s537a.
